clearedSpotChecks.check: Which instruction set the Lagoon spec id selects in op-revm.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-reth/v2.11.0-rc.1/rust/op-revm/src/spec.rs (HTTP 200). Lines 48-50 map Self::KARST | Self::LAGOON to SpecId::OSAKA, and the test at line 280 asserts it. In op-revm/src/handler.rs at the same tag the word Lagoon does not occur. In op-revm/src/precompiles.rs line 39 selects lagoon(), and lines 123-132 replace only the BLS12-381 G1 MSM, G2 MSM and pairing entries with lower input limits. src/ never calls those addresses with input it builds, so the opcode table that FullMath, TickMath and SqrtPriceMath run on is the Osaka table.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Lagoon metering settlement as implemented in alloy-op-evm block/mod.rs at op-reth v2.11.0-rc.1, and the refund policy that ships with it.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched alloy-op-evm/src/block/mod.rs, post_exec/null.rs and post_exec/mod.rs at op-reth/v2.11.0-rc.1 (HTTP 200 each). The doc comment at block/mod.rs:831-836 states that evm.transact has already run and the deltas are applied before commit. apply_post_exec_refund_to_state (lines 894-921) credits the sender and debits the beneficiary, BASE_FEE_RECIPIENT and OPERATOR_FEE_RECIPIENT, and sub_state_balance (lines 795-813) uses checked_sub, which fails the block on underflow. Deposits and the post-exec transaction get no adjustment (line 845). post_exec/mod.rs:7 exports only NullRefundPolicy, whose finish_tx returns the default with no refund and whose inspect_step is empty. No EVM frame runs after the adjustment, and src/PoolManager.sol:349-364 credits native only from msg.value, so a later balance change at the PoolManager cannot become a delta.

clearedSpotChecks.check: A deposit with value addressed to the PoolManager itself.
clearedSpotChecks.note: grep over src/ outside src/test finds no receive() or fallback() and only two payable functions, settle and settleFor at src/PoolManager.sol:300 and :305, both behind onlyWhenUnlocked (src/PoolManager.sol:96-99). eth_call with value 1 wei and a state override for the sender reverts on both deployed PoolManagers: on chain 10 (https://mainnet.optimism.io, 0x9a13f98cb987694c9f086b1f5eb990eea8264ec3) empty calldata reverts with no data and settle() (0x11da60b4) reverts with 0x54e3ca0d, the locked selector that the compiled bytecode in cycles/009/core-code-optimizer-bug.work/preL3.yul:1160 uses. Chain 7777777 (https://rpc.zora.energy/, 0x0575338e4c17006ae181b47900a84404247ca30f) gives the same two results. A failed deposit keeps its mint at the from address (op-revm/src/handler.rs:517-531 at v2.11.0-rc.1, saturating_add at line 531). Even ETH forced in some other way stays stranded, because _settle reads msg.value and no balance for native (src/PoolManager.sol:353-355).
